version: v1.1 (step 1 accepted by lead <agent>, DECISIONS D9; lexical duplicates removed)
rule: units = retained morph features (AAE) and lexical items (AAE lexicon; SGE particles + lexicon, since SGE is carried by CR_lex, PREREG §2.2);
within each (variety, tier) rank units by sha1('P3-split-v1|variety|tier|unit') and alternate F_train, F_heldout in rank order (balance +-1).
F_train builds the DPO pairs; F_heldout is evaluation only. Features not retained (gate/FP audit) are in neither list.
lexicon_source: notes/lexicons/{aae,sge}.json, status==VARIETY only (CHECK/dictionary-only items may be used in transforms but are not detector features until they pass P/R + FP audit; D7)

SGE: finish_completive/can_cannot are retained but thin: morph descriptive only

change_from_v1: removed 'gon' and "y'all" from AAE.lex (duplicates of morph finna_gon / yall); no re-ranking, no other change
